column1: # OpenLogic/LICENSE.md records the Open Logic Text's CC BY 4.0 attribution
# terms.  It is evidence for the cited source material, not a license choice
# for new FormalOLP Lean code.  The ten `native-adaptation` rows also retain
# all three Pool license/notice records.  The two `existing-scaffold` rows
# predate the native Pool-guided integrations and therefore cite only the OLP
# attribution record.  The last column points to the applicable ledger.
# The scope contains ten new integration children and two pre-existing
# Mathlib-backed scaffold files.  The source kind makes that distinction
# explicit instead of treating every native file as Pool-adapted.
